title: Useless and would not stop promoting their subscription
body:
Whenever I opened the app I would keep showing a “limited time offer” for their premium subscription. Except whenever the timer for the “limited offer” ran out a new identical one would start. Tried emailing support about getting rid of the annoying ad since it turned me off from the app so much. Got no reply so had to deinstall it. 

Pretty app but very limited user functions unless you paid for the premium that they would NEVER let you forget about. Do not recommend.
